headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalCompletionWidth.coarseRows_total
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ)
  (hr : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn r)).length)
  (z : Math115.ReducedSmallChain.States r c U L),
  ∑ i, Math115.LegacyPhysicalCompletion.coarseRows r c U L hr z i =
    ∑ i,
      OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.residualRows
        (OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall r c U) (Math115.ReducedSmallChain.capacity r c U L) r c
        L z i

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalCompletionWidth.coarseDimension_le
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U : ℕ),
  0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn r)).length →
    0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn c)).length →
      OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.dimensionAllowance ≤
        OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.dimensionAllowance

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalCompletionWidth.completionBits_le_uniform
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ)
  (hr : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn r)).length)
  (hc : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn c)).length)
  (z : Math115.ReducedSmallChain.States r c U L) (h : ℕ),
  Math115.LegacyPhysicalCompletion.bits r c U L hr hc z h ≤
    Math115.PhysicalCompletionWidth.uniformCompletionBits r c U L h
